title: Get listed
intro1: Pana MIA is a directory of South Florida's independent makers, shops, artists, bands, co-ops and non-profits. Getting listed is free.
intro2: Seven short steps, one question at a time. No account needed yet.
step1Heading: Why are you filling out this form?
step1Desc: A quick read before you start.
step2Desc: What you're listing, and whether you qualify.
step3Desc: Your listing contact, plus the option to create an account and manage it.
step4Desc: Optional — skip it if it doesn't apply.
step5Desc: This is your introduction to the community.
step6Desc: Links, and where your business is based or can be visited.
introBody: Your answers create a listing in our Local Directory, separate from your personal Pana account. Connect your account now or claim the listing later to edit it.
introEmphasis: Please be as honest and clear as possible to ensure the directory is accurate as possible.
introContact: If you have questions please reach out to us at
step1Body: Seven short steps. You can go back and change anything before you submit.
step2Body: A real person reviews every submission so the directory stays local and legit.
step3Title: Connect your Pana account or claim it later
step3Body: Already signed in? Use your Pana account in step 3. Otherwise, add your personal email for a secure sign-in link, then accept the listing invitation.
listingTypeQuestion: What kind of listing are you creating?
listingTypeNote: This is what places you in the directory.
listingTypeDirectory: A business, band, co-op, non-profit or project
listingTypeHybrid: Both — I'm listing my work and keeping a personal presence
locallyBasedQuestion: Are you (the creator, director, owner, CEO) locally-based or a native of South Florida?
locallyBasedNote: South Florida is Miami-Dade, Broward and Palm Beach County.
locallyBasedNo: I'm not (and therefore do not qualify to be a member of this club)
nameLabel: Name of your business, band, co-op or project
nameNote: This name will display as the title of your profile.
emailNote: We send the submission confirmation and review updates here. Use an address your team checks. It is not displayed publicly.
emailChoiceTitle: Which email should receive listing updates?
emailCopyNote: This copies the address into this listing. You can edit it separately later; changing your Pana email will not change it.
manageWithPana: Manage this listing with my Pana account ({{email}})
manageWithPanaNote: Your account stays personal, even if the listing uses a different contact email. Uncheck this if you are submitting for someone else; you can invite them below or leave it unclaimed.
accountOptionTitle: Want an account to manage this listing?
accountOptionBody: Add your personal email below. After you submit, we'll send a secure link to create or sign into your Pana account. Then accept the invitation to manage this listing and follow its review. You can skip this and claim the listing later.
personalEmailLabel: Personal email for your Pana account (optional)
personalEmailNote: Use the address you want for your personal Pana account, not necessarily the business inbox. It can be the same address if you only use one. Leave it empty to submit without an account or on someone else's behalf.
personalEmailReady: After you submit, we'll send the account and claim link to {{email}}.
phoneNote: Only used by our team if we need to reach you. Never shown publicly.
pronounsNote: If you are an individual (not representing a group or org).
detailsPlaceholder: Tell us what you make, who it's for, and where in South Florida you're based.
detailsNote: This will be your intro to our users! A trimmed snippet of this shows in directory search. Please include where you are based in SoFlo :)
fiveWordsLabel: Give us five words that describe what you do
fiveWordsNote: A few words. This is what people see first in the directory.
tagsLabel: Tags people can find you with in our directory
tagsNote: Pick every one that fits. These power the filters on directory search.
linksNote: Add at least one so we can confirm you're really local. These are displayed on your profile.
storefrontLabel: I have a physical address people can visit
storefrontNote: Only provide a public visiting address — never your home.
locationModeLabel: How do customers find your business?
onlineBusinessLabel: Online business, without a public storefront
mobileBusinessLabel: Mobile, by appointment, or another setup
onlineZipNote: Required for online businesses, including those offering delivery or arranged pickup. Only your five-digit ZIP area is shown on the public map, not a street address. Delivery and pickup details must be confirmed with the business.
hoursNote: Free-form — write them however your visitors would read them.
hearAboutUsLabel: How did you hear about us? (optional)
hearAboutUsPlaceholder: A friend, Instagram, a market, another pana...
tosIntroTail: which includes our general terms, our privacy policy, and permission to accept email and SMS marketing.
tosCheckbox: I agree to the Terms & Conditions
turnstileBlocked: Verification could not load. Please refresh the page and try again.
turnstileNote: Protected by Cloudflare Turnstile. No tracking, no cookies.
errLocallyBased: Please let us know whether you're based in South Florida.
errName: Please enter the name of your listing (at least 2 characters).
errEmail: Please enter a valid email address.
errPersonalEmail: That doesn't look like a valid email address. Fix it or leave it empty — it's optional.
errReviewContact: Your Pana sign-in changed. Please confirm the listing contact and management choice again.
errDetails: Please tell us a little more about your project.
errFiveWords: Please tell us what you do in a few words.
errLinks: Please add a website or an Instagram handle so we can find you.
errLocationMode: Please choose how customers find your business.
errOnlineZip: Please enter a valid five-digit ZIP code for where your online business is based.
errAddress: Please add the street address for your storefront.
errCity: Please add the city for your storefront.
errTos: Please accept the Terms & Conditions to submit.
successBody: We've received your listing. Review updates will go to {{email}}.
successManagedBody: You can manage this listing from your existing Pana account. Its contact email is separate from your personal sign-in.
successNextManaged: Open your account to follow the review and manage your listing.
successAccountTitle: One more step to manage your listing
successPersonalEmail: We sent a secure sign-in link to {{email}}. Open it to create or sign into your Pana account, then accept the invitation to manage this listing.
successInvitationPending: Your invitation is saved for {{email}}, but we could not send the sign-in link. Sign in with that address later to accept it; your listing submission is complete.
successNextInvitationPending: Sign in with the personal address you provided to accept the saved invitation. You do not need to submit the listing again.
successNext1: Our team reviews your submission, usually within a few days.
successNextAccount: Open the sign-in email we sent to your personal address to create or connect your account and claim the listing.
successNextNoAccount: You skipped the account step. Your application is still complete, and you can create an account and claim the listing later.
successNext2: Once approved, your listing goes live in the directory and you can add photos, hours and more.
